html: Prenatal visits let you and your care team follow your health and your baby's growth from the start. Try to schedule the first one as soon as you know you're pregnant.

• Questions about your health, medicines and family history
  • A physical exam
  • Blood and urine tests
  • An estimated due date
  • A conversation about optional screening tests

• Take a daily prenatal vitamin with folic acid
  • Skip alcohol, smoking and recreational drugs
  • Check with your care team before starting or stopping any medicine
Heavy bleeding, strong cramping or belly pain, a high fever, or vomiting so constant you can't keep anything down.

title: Prenatal care: the first trimester
abstract: What happens at early prenatal visits, and habits that support a healthy start.
